name: Route Map Generator
description: Plot locations or optimise multi-stop routes. Produces PNG map + markdown table; optional Leaflet HTML (road-following via OSRM), GeoJSON, KML, CSV, deep links (Google Maps / Apple Maps / Bing Maps), and QR code sheets. Fully offline Python engine — accepts lat/lon from user input, prior tools (Dataverse, CRM, SharePoint), or agent web search.
author: Nazish Qasim
